category_title: Students accustomed to strict, non-negotiable disciplinary models
minimal_context: The teacher is attempting to begin whole-class instruction while the students are in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, I need to teach the class now. Let's get started.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Continues speaking loudly to a classmate) So anyway, I was telling him that we should go after school...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I will wait for everyone to stop talking before I talk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Laughs with classmate) Look, it seems that she gets upset. But they do not punish them or do anything. They wait for them to stop talking instead of telling them to be quiet.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I am still waiting for silence so we can begin.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Just keep talking. They cannot hit us or punish us physically here. Sometimes we do certain things based on our knowledge of what they can and cannot do to us.
